card.name: The word work before up (workup)
card.fires_on: The word "work" in "workup" when it follows an adjective like appropriate, infectious or diagnostic. It appears in warnings about suspected adverse reactions or infections.

modes.label: Workup after appropriate/infectious/diagnostic
modes.description: "work" begins the word workup, which refers to testing to rule out other causes.
